name: 信阳师范大学校园网登录
description: 适用于信阳师范大学锐捷 Ruijie ePortal 认证页面，无需选择运营商，填写账号密码即可登录。

steps.script: (() => { window.__authState = { url: location.href, title: document.title, bodyLen: (document.body.innerText || '').length }; return true; })()

(() => { const val = ({{username}} || '').trim(); if (!val) throw new Error('账号为空'); const vis = el => { if (!el) return false; const s = getComputedStyle(el); if (!s || s.display==='none' || s.visibility==='hidden') return false; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width>2 && r.height>2; }; const ok = el => el && !el.disabled && !el.readOnly; const ctx = el => [el.placeholder, el.getAttribute('aria-label'), el.name, el.id, el.className, el.labels&&el.labels[0]&&el.labels[0].innerText, el.closest('label')&&el.closest('label').innerText].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase(); const score = el => { const t = String(el.type||'').toLowerCase(); let s = 0; if (t==='text'||t==='email'||t==='tel'||t==='') s+=5; if (t==='password'||t==='hidden') s-=30; const c = ctx(el); if (/账号|帐号|用户名|使用者|学号|工号|教职工|手机号|手机|user.?name|login.?id|account|userid|student/i.test(c)) s+=20; if (/密码|pass|验证码|code|captcha|sms/i.test(c)) s-=12; if (el.closest('[class*=login]')||el.closest('[id*=login]')) s+=3; if (el.autocomplete==='username'||el.autocomplete==='email') s+=5; return s; }; const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea')).filter(el=>vis(el)&&ok(el)); const pick = all.slice().sort((a,b)=>score(b)-score(a))[0]; if (!pick||score(pick)<1) throw new Error('未识别到账号输入框'); pick.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('focus',{bubbles:true}));const nativeSet=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;nativeSet.call(pick,'');pick.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('beforeinput',{bubbles:true,inputType:'insertText',data:val}));nativeSet.call(pick,val);pick.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,inputType:'insertText',data:val}));pick.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{bubbles:true}));pick.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));pick.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('blur',{bubbles:true}));return true; })()

(() => { const val = ({{password}} || '').trim(); if (!val) throw new Error('密码为空'); const vis = el => { if (!el) return false; const s = getComputedStyle(el); if (!s || s.display==='none' || s.visibility==='hidden') return false; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width>2 && r.height>2; }; const ok = el => el && !el.disabled && !el.readOnly; const ctx = el => [el.placeholder, el.getAttribute('aria-label'), el.name, el.id, el.className, el.labels&&el.labels[0]&&el.labels[0].innerText].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase(); const score = el => { const t = String(el.type||'').toLowerCase(); let s = 0; if (t==='password') s+=30; if (t==='password'&&!vis(el)) s-=5; const c = ctx(el); if (/密码|pass|passwd|pwd|口令/i.test(c)) s+=16; if (/账号|用户名|user|account/i.test(c)) s-=10; if (/确认|confirm|repeat|再次/i.test(c)) s-=20; return s; }; const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea')).filter(el=>ok(el)); const pick = all.slice().sort((a,b)=>score(b)-score(a))[0]; if (!pick||score(pick)<1) throw new Error('未识别到密码输入框'); pick.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('focus',{bubbles:true}));const nativeSet=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;nativeSet.call(pick,'');pick.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('beforeinput',{bubbles:true,inputType:'insertText',data:val}));nativeSet.call(pick,val);pick.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,inputType:'insertText',data:val}));pick.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{bubbles:true}));pick.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));pick.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('blur',{bubbles:true}));return true; })()

(()=>{const loginLink=document.getElementById('loginLink');if(loginLink){loginLink.click();return true;}const vis=el=>{if(!el)return false;const s=getComputedStyle(el);if(!s||s.display==='none'||s.visibility==='hidden')return false;const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>4&&r.height>4;};const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,div,button,input[type=submit]')).filter(vis);for(let el of all){const onclick=el.getAttribute('onclick')||'';if(onclick.includes('doauthen')||onclick.includes('login')){el.click();return true;}}throw new Error('未找到登录按钮');})()

(()=>{if(document.getElementById('toLogOut')){return'登录成功'}const t=document.querySelectorAll('a,div,button,input[type=submit]');for(let e of t){const o=e.getAttribute('onclick')||'';const i=e.innerText||'';if(o.includes('logout')||i.includes('下线')||i.includes('退出')){return'登录成功'}if(o.includes('login')||o.includes('doauthen')||i.includes('登录')||i.includes('认证')){return'登录失败/未登录'}}return'状态未知'})()

on_failure.message: 登录失败，请检查账号密码或认证地址。
